description.value: Maple Leaf Pizza is a pizza takeout and delivery shop on West Broadway in Vancouver offering a broad menu of specialty pies with unlimited toppings. The shop operates through an online ordering platform and serves both pickup and delivery customers. A cyclist stopping along the busy West Broadway corridor will find a wide range of options including several vegetarian-friendly pizzas.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (6 spaces) at 87m; rack (6 spaces) at 95m. Total: 12 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is a working online ordering menu for Maple Leaf Pizza in Vancouver, BC, confirming the business is real and active. The menu explicitly lists pickup-only and delivery-only sections, confirming takeout service; multiple vegetarian pizzas (Gourmet Vegetarian, The Vegetarian Diavola, Veggie Pizza) are listed. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: The OSM website URL points to a third-party online ordering platform (happidealsorders.ca) rather than the business's own domain — no independent business website was available to cross-check the phone number or street address.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active pizza takeout business on West Broadway in Vancouver with a functioning online ordering menu. A useful food stop for touring cyclists.

Takeout.detail: Website shows dedicated 'Pick Up Specials ONLY' menu sections with multiple pizza sizes and specialty pizzas labeled 'Pickup only'

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Multiple vegetarian pizzas listed: Gourmet Vegetarian (spinach, artichoke hearts, pesto, feta), The Vegetarian Diavola (mushroom, spinach, roasted red peppers), and Veggie Pizza (mushrooms, onions, green peppers, tomatoes). No vegan or GF options confirmed
